narr: Pre-frontal storms developed in eastern Ohio on the afternoon of August 21st. Broken cloud coverage in the warm sector enhanced MLCAPE to 1500J/kg; effective shear was modest at 25-30kt. However, it was enough to produce quarter-size hail in discrete cells.
ev: Locus Avenue in Zanesville was flooded near SR 60 from heavy rainfall.
lsr: REPORT OF LOCUS AVENUE FLOODED NEAR SR 60 FROM HEAVY RAINS. MINOR FLOODING ALSO SEEN ALONG SMALL PORTIONS OF I-70 AND US40 AS A RESULT OF NEARBY CONSTRUCTION.
